notes.title: Introduction to New Dungeon System Playing Method
notes.notes:
As the focus of this update, the dungeon system will appear in a brand new form in the city of the game.

1. Players can enter the dungeon by clicking on the dungeon building. The roles they enter must be above level 20, including level 20.

2. The monsters in the dungeon include map monsters and some unique monsters, and have melee, remote, magic, skills... It's almost impossible to pass automatic attacks on the party.

3. There are 15 layers in the dungeon. The maximum amount of blue can be restored to 50% for each layer of the dungeon. No props can be used.

4. Enter the dungeon can only choose five mercenaries, the protagonist is not required, after the formation system can be a number of players to send troops, but the maximum can only be five.

5. A small amount of gold is required to enter the dungeon.

6. The level of the monster in the dungeon is the same as that of the mercenary entering the dungeon.

7. If you can't fight halfway, or when all the people are killed, you will automatically return to the current city, and the next time you go in, you will continue to have the last number of layers.

8. Reward, get all the rewards when breaking the last level. The dungeon will reward all kinds of special items, including washing points, washing, nationality books, all kinds of monster debris, legendary equipment debris, even diamonds, 100% chance of getting one of the above items when breaking the first time, and 20% chance later, dungeon in all cities. Everyone can go and play it once. Dungeon monsters don't get heart and experience values.

9. The map in the dungeon will have various branches. If you encounter a treasure box branch, you will be rewarded accordingly. This place is the same as the traditional dungeon game.

10. City owners can either close dungeons or choose to open only to certain business groups.

This edition has made great adjustments to the maps of Nordic and Western Regions, from the overall appearance of the map, to the display of monsters, and then to the size of the map, which comprehensively solved the previous slots. Comments are welcome.

The next version will make some of the tools in the bazaar work, such as shovels, shovels on the ground, stones, shovels and so on.
